shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 13 '"'^## (DashKit|Charts|Navigation)'"' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit@latest peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@3 peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts@1 @gravity-ui/navigation@3 @gravity-ui/icons@2'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -190; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -40'
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/{dashkit,charts,navigation,uikit} | rg '(types|AsideHeader|Button|Select|Modal|TextInput).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -55"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/{plugin,config}.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts | head -135; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -170; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | rg '(series/(area|pie|line)|chart|axis).*d.ts' | head -20; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -55; rg -n 'export.*(Layout|Chart|Bell|Gear|CircleQuestion|Plus|Arrow|Ellipsis|Calendar|Grip|Magnifier|House|Users|Folder|Check|Xmark|Bars|ChartColumn|Shopping)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/common.d.ts | head -160"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 65 '(interface Plugin|interface Settings|interface PluginWidget)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/*.d.ts; rg -n -A 55 '(interface MenuItem|interface LogoProps)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg 'types/(chart|series|axis|legend)' | head -35; rg 'export.*(Layout|ChartColumn|Bell|Gear|CircleQuestion|Plus|Ellipsis|Calendar|Grip|Magnifier|House|Persons|Folder|Check|Xmark|ShoppingBag|Sliders|ArrowShape)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | tail -45"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/{area,line,pie}.d.ts | head -180; rg -n -A 8 'categories|labels\\??:|grid\\??:|visible\\??:|min\\??:|max\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -85; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/types.d.ts | head -75; rg -n -- '--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -30; rg 'export.*(LayoutCells|ChartColumn|Bell|Gear|CircleQuestion|Ellipsis|Calendar|Grip|House|ArrowRight|ArrowUpRight|CircleCheck|ArrowDownToLine)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 8 'innerRadius|borderRadius|data:|value:|color:|name:|radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/pie.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/types.d.ts | head -60; rg -n -- '--gn-aside|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css 2>/dev/null | head -20; rg -n 'visible|grid|categories' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -22; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/Chart/Chart.d.ts | head -55; rg -n 'get.*Settings|cols:|rowHeight:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/*.js | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 30 'interface ChartAxisLabels' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; rg -n 'switcher|render|children' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; rg -n -A 40 'interface ItemProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderItem/AsideHeaderItem.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Item/Item.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg '(AsideHeader.*css|variables.css)"'$'"' | head -15; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js | head -45; rg -n 'CSS API|--gn' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -20; rg -n 'interpolation|curve' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/{line,area,series}.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 20 'numberFormat|formatter' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -45; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build | rg 'Item.d.ts"'$|'"\\.css"'$'"' | head -22; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -70; rg -n 'type ReactGridLayoutProps|interface ReactGridLayoutProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/*.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '(css|scss)"'$'"' | head -20; rg -n -- 'width|item-current|background-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -18; rg -n 'isResizable|noOverlay|draggableHandleClassName' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -25; cat index.html; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--gn-aside-header[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js | sort -u | head -30; rg -n -A 18 'isResizable|draggableHandle:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -50; rg -n 'isResizable|draggableHandle:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/*.js | head -20; rg -n 'interpolation' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts | tail -4"
